topics.description: The Feeding Our Future fraud case in Minnesota has seen multiple guilty pleas and the leader, Aimee Bock, is set to be sentenced in May. The case involves a large-scale food assistance program fraud.
topics.reason: Guilty pleas and sentencing indicate case is nearing conclusion

topics.description: A federal investigation is underway into the Rogers Park shooting, with additional arrests made and an 18-year-old detained. The incident has sparked concerns about public safety.
topics.reason: Federal involvement indicates severity of case
